prompt: A compound has molecular formula C₆H₁₂. What is its degree of unsaturation (hydrogen deficiency index, HDI)?

options.label: 1 — either one ring OR one π bond
0 — a saturated acyclic compound with no rings or π bonds
2 — one ring and one π bond, or two rings, or two π bonds
3 — three π bonds, or a mix of rings and π bonds

explanation: HDI = (2n + 2 − H) / 2 for CₙHₕ. (2·6 + 2 − 12)/2 = 2/2 = 1. One DoU means either a ring OR a π bond. C₆H₁₂ fits cyclohexane (ring) or 1-hexene (π). Rule of thumb: saturated acyclic CₙH₂ₙ₊₂; each DoU subtracts 2 H.
